deployment.statement: This package PREPARES a governed staging deployment. No deployment, redeploy, alias move, promotion, Git auto-deploy change or merge was performed by OC-5R-PROV-01.

candidate.frontend_sha: the deploy commit — code_sha itself, or a descendant that changes only docs/** and this branch's two governed pairing records
candidate.backend_sha: the same deploy commit as the frontend (one monorepo commit; the gates require frontend == backend == candidate head)

projects.stable_aliases: carup-staging.vercel.app and carup-backend-staging.vercel.app are NOT moved; the pair resolver refuses them as non-candidate origins
projects.git_auto_deploy: disabled (vercel.json git.deploymentEnabled:false) — deploying is an explicit, governed action

database.role: canonical staging database (OC-5R DB convergence: SOURCE PASS + DATABASE PASS)
database.migrations: none introduced by OC-5R-PROV-01; the read-only post-convergence manifest recertification is recorded in the readiness report

frontend.basis: Vercel's stable per-branch alias for carup-staging; 60 characters, so it is not truncated

backend.basis: Vercel truncates this per-branch alias (it exceeds 63 characters) and appends a hash it assigns at the branch's first preview deployment. The hash is not composed by hand: it is read from that deployment's alias list and recorded in a pairing-only commit.

procedure: 1. Deploy the BACKEND preview of the deploy commit (carup-backend-staging, target preview, branch fix/oc5r-real-runtime-source-closure); read its stable per-branch alias from the deployment's alias list.
2. Commit ONLY the two pairing records for this branch (frontend value above; backend alias from step 1). Verify the commit with the verify command — it must pass with pairing 'present'.
3. Deploy BOTH previews from that pairing commit (the frontend embeds the pairing at build time, so the deployed frontend commit must contain it). Re-verify with the verify command.

4. Dispatch Seller Home & Lifecycle Staging UAT and Diaspora Deployed Staging UAT on the branch head; each proves the governed exact-head pair (resolve-governed-preview-pair.mjs) before any staging contact.
